# Flipper the Ripper

> Free, open-source (MIT) Android app that saves publicly accessible videos from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X and Dailymotion to the phone's gallery. Share a link to the app and the download starts. No account, no ads, no tracking. Not on Google Play by design; distributed as a signed APK.

## Get the app

- Newest APK, always: https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/download (302 redirect to the current GitHub release asset)
- This page as Markdown (with the current version and SHA-256): https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/index.md — also served at / for `Accept: text/markdown`
- Newest release as JSON: https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/latest.json — fields `version`, `name`, `url`, `size` (bytes), `sha256`, `published` (ISO 8601), `notes`
- All releases and notes: https://github.com/pepperonas/flipper-the-ripper/releases
- Requirements: Android 7.0 or later, 64-bit ARM (every phone sold since about 2016). One APK, nothing to choose.

## Install

1. Open https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/download on the phone.
2. Open the downloaded file; allow the browser to install apps when Android asks (once).
3. In any supported app tap Share and pick Flipper the Ripper. Updates install over the existing app; the app announces new releases itself.

## Verify

- APK checksum: `sha256` in https://flipper-the-ripper.celox.io/latest.json, also `SHA256SUMS.txt` in each release.
- Signing certificate SHA-256 (identical for every release since 1.0.0): `1fc3904fd80eb8135b25ee15fe62ec3b74545eba360298c152f712646fd910cb` — check with `apksigner verify --print-certs`.

## Features

- Platforms: YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Dailymotion
- Share-sheet integration and clipboard detection; one-tap download
- Quality: Best, 1080p, 720p, 480p, audio only
- Queue: one download at a time, pause/resume from the last byte, drag to reorder, swipe finished entries away with undo
- Background downloads with one progress notification; files saved to Movies, named after the video title
- Self-updating yt-dlp extractor
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, Italian, French

## Scope and limits

- Only for publicly accessible content and personal, lawful use. Does not bypass DRM, paywalls or access restrictions.
- No playlists, no subtitles.
